Module awtzero

module awtzero
Provides the core classes for the awtzero graphics and game development library.

This package contains fundamental building blocks such as Rect for collision and manipulation, Vector2 for 2D math, and core I/O components like Keyboard and Mouse. It aims to simplify graphics programming using the Java AWT toolkit.

Key Classes:

  • Window: The main application window and rendering surface.
  • Screen: A simplified interface for drawing graphics.
  • Keyboard: Keyboard input handling.
  • Mouse: Mouse input handling.
  • Surface: A drawable surface similar to pygame Surfaces.
  • RenderInstance: Provides drawing capabilities on Surfaces.
  • Rect: A rectangle class for positioning and collision detection.
  • Vector2: A 2D vector class for mathematical operations.
  • ImageWrapper: A utility class for image loading and manipulation.
Some important notes:
  • (0, 0) refers to the top left. Therefore, negative y refers towards the top, and negative x refers to the left
  • For operations involving Vector2, -90 degrees refers to the top, 0 to the right, 90 degrees to the bottom, and 180 to the left (clockwise)
This library is inspired by pygame and aims to provide a familiar and easy-to-use API for developers looking to create graphics applications in Java using AWT.
